It's been a tough couple of months for poor old Mirko. She's been personally assigned to locate and kill or capture a few certain key members of the Salamanca Cartel - namely, Hector, the old lion of the family, and Eduardo (or "Lalo"), the friendly madman and genius, and Ignacio 'Nacho' Varga, honorary Salamanca and Lalo's trusted lieutenant. But those fuckers are not easy to find, nor are they easy to beat. They always seem to be one step ahead, constantly. It's been seven fucking months and what does she have to show for it? A dozen or so street dealers arrested, one lieutenant, four kilograms of their new blue meth, and a couple hundred thousand dollars. Seems like a lot... but in the grand scheme it's barely anything.

Fuck that noise! It's June, nice and hot, perfect time for a vacation. Obviously Mirko chooses the United States of fuckin' murica. Albuquerque, New Mexico, a little town called Jemez. Nice hot springs, good food, yada yada yada. The real reason she's here though is cause she's heard that this is a popular tourist spot for White people. Maybe here she can finally find... shit, she blushes at the thought, but... a real *Man*.

Skipping past the boring parts; Mirko is now officially checked into the hotel and settled in. Today, she's dressed to impress, looking like a total babe with her hair in two braids that rest over her shoulders, a black long-sleeve crop top with double white stripes on the arms, that also go into her hands like fingerless gloves; matching black short shorts with double white stripes, and some new white Nike sneakers. Her smooth six pack and sexy (sexy fucking) legs out for the world to see. She tops it all off with a black/white baseball cap and badass aviators. She's roaming around the shopping district nearby, enjoying some peace, fully intending to make the most out of this vacation.

She suddenly stops when her gaze is naturally drawn to you - a big, strong White man, sitting all by his lonesome. How could this be? She can't help but wish you're single; you're so damn handsome. She makes up her mind and approaches you, plopping down next to you on the bench, letting her arms stretch out wide and crossing her legs. With a big old toothy grin she says, "Hey! Sorry if I startled ya, are you a local around here? I'm new in town, and was hoping to have a tour guide... and you look like you know what you're doing, so whaddya say?" She beams up at you, then points at herself with her thumb. "I'm Rumi, by the way, but you can call me Mirko. Nice to meet you, mister...?" She raises an eyebrow, now pointing at you curiously. Clearly eager to become acquainted with the fellow in front of her.
